items.author: Aigul S.
items.text: I booked a general cleaning after six months of not having the energy to deal with my apartment. The team arrived on time, worked for about 4 hours, and left it looking like a brand new place. I was especially happy they got the kitchen spotless — they even took apart the range hood to clean it.

items.author: Timur A.
items.text: I hired them to wash the facade of my shop on Chuy — the windows were streaked after winter. They came with a lift, finished everything in a couple of hours, not a single scratch on the glass. I'll be a regular customer.

items.author: Nuria K.
items.text: Sofa dry cleaning — genuinely saved a sofa I was ready to throw out after my kid went at it with markers. They got almost all of the stain out, just a faint shadow left, which is a minor thing. I appreciated that there was no strong chemical smell.

items.author: Maksim V.
items.text: Post-renovation cleaning — exactly what we needed. Drywall dust was everywhere, I didn't think it was possible to get it that clean. They quoted the price upfront and there were no surprise charges afterward.

items.author: Zhamilya T.
items.text: I've been on the weekly apartment cleaning plan for three months now — really convenient, the same person always comes and already knows all the details of my place. Paying for the subscription genuinely works out cheaper than booking one-off cleanings.

items.author: Bekzat I.
items.text: We booked an office cleaning ahead of our opening — 5 offices plus an open space. They finished right on schedule, everything was spotless before the investors arrived. The only thing is we had to wait a bit for the time to be confirmed, but the pricing was completely fair.

items.author: Darya M.
items.text: Dry cleaning for the chairs at my beauty salon — there were awful hair dye stains I thought would never come out. They came out completely! The technician worked carefully and didn't get anything else dirty around it.

items.author: Erlan Zh.
items.text: We were moving into a new apartment and booked a move-in cleaning — the developer had left construction dust everywhere. The team washed the windows, floors and bathrooms. The price matched what the site quoted, no surprises.
